gap: No result ChatGPT got states what the Thinkware ARC 800 side-camera setup costs: the ARC 800 at $279.99, a $99.99 Multiplexer Box (TWA-MB100) and a $159.98 pair of Exterior Side View Cameras (TWA-NEXTS60(2)), $539.96 in all at thinkwarestore.com on 2026-11-21. None of them says that Thinkware's own page for the side-camera pair leaves the ARC 800 off its compatible-dash-cam list, while the Multiplexer Box page and Thinkware's support article include it.
standout_why: I compared five pages. The Thinkware help article ChatGPT cited lists the dash cams that work with the multiplexer (ARC 800 included) and says how to wire a right-side camera, but it gives no price and does not mention the side-camera pack's narrower list. DashCamTalk (cited) never mentions a multiplexer or exterior side cameras; its only 4-channel pick, the Vantrue N5S, is front, rear and two cabin cameras. On caraudioradar and gearjury (top results, not cited) the Thinkware multiplexer never comes up, neither shows prices, and neither gives add-on costs or compatibility lists. Car and Driver (cited) could not be fetched, and the Tom's Guide article body did not load, so I could not check either. ChatGPT's answer priced the ARC 800 as '$279.99 base dash cam only' and never added up the multiplexer and side cameras.
decides: This supports one of the products we link as the value pick. The Thinkware route is the only setup here with true exterior, IP68 side cameras, but it costs $539.96 across three Thinkware store items on 2026-11-21. It also needs the multiplexer wired in and a wire cut on the right-hand camera, and Thinkware's own pages disagree on whether the side cameras support the ARC 800. The Botslab G980H 4-Camera ({price:botslab-g980h-4-camera-dash-cam} at the store, {after:botslab-g980h-4-camera-dash-cam} through our link) is one box with left and right cameras included. It places in the top three as the all-in-one side-coverage pick. The ARC 800 kit stays the premium choice for exterior-mounted side cameras, with a warning to confirm with Thinkware that the side cameras work on the ARC 800 before buying. The Vantrue N5S stays out: its extra two cameras face the cabin.
